changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE vaultnote.users ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, email VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL, display_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, email_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT pk_users PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uk_users_email UNIQUE (email) );
